# Browser media vendor bundle

`mediabunny.js` is generated by `npm run build:vendor` from:

- Mediabunny 1.62.0
- @mediabunny/aac-encoder 1.62.0

Both packages are distributed under the Mozilla Public License 2.0. Their
source code is available from <https://github.com/Vanilagy/mediabunny> and the
exact package versions are recorded in the repository's `package-lock.json`.

The AAC extension contains a size-optimized browser WebAssembly build of
FFmpeg's AAC encoder. See its upstream source and build instructions at
<https://github.com/Vanilagy/mediabunny/tree/main/packages/aac-encoder>.

The SIGNAL application and its original source remain MIT-licensed. The
third-party bundle is covered by its own license in `MPL-2.0.txt`.
